draft_en.subject: One question — Marvell Industrial Alert System
draft_en.body:
Hi Tim,

We have sent you a few mails on "Marvell Industrial Alert System" and you never had a reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

Alongside the Omnitron OmniConverter range you distribute, we supply industrial gigabit and PoE media converters and DIN-rail 8-PoE + 2 SFP switches (−40~75 °C, CE/RoHS/UKCA, neutral packing) from small lots, EXW USD — is there a budget MC or PoE position your customers ask for below the Omnitron line?

Reference price: DIN-rail 1-GE + 1-SFP industrial switch / media converter (STI-110GE) $26.5 USD EXW, MOQ 1 pc, 15-day validity, 3-year warranty.

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
